items.title: Counting backwards: The prior-price rule and the regulation of discount claims in Indian e-commerce
items.summary: A discount is a comparison and a comparison is only as reliable as its reference point. A struck-through figure beside a lower price represents that the lower price is a genuine concession. Indian law has so far policed that representation only after the event, through the general prohibition on misleading advertisements. The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026 , notified on September 9, 2026 and in force from January 1, 2027, add a direct rule. Rule 4(13) requires an e-commerce entity or seller that announces a price reduction to disclose a “prior price” alongside the reduced price. This article argues that Rule 4(13) rests on a sound benchmark but leaves four questions open: what period the benchmark covers, how prominently it must be shown, who bears the duty on a marketplace and how a claim can be tested. It reads the rule against the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Court of Justice of the European Union’s decision in Aldi Süd , which interprets a provision with the same 30-day benchmark. items.title: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav found dead in Delhi
items.summary: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav, 42, was found dead near his SUV close to Maujpur metro station in northeast Delhi on Tuesday night, October 27. Delhi Police said the preliminary investigation suggests he may have died by suicide. The circumstances surrounding his death remain unclear, and a postmortem examination is underway at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital as on Wednesday. According to the Indian Express, Yadav was found unconscious beside his black Scorpio-N by a female friend at around 9 pm. The two had travelled from Sonipat to Delhi earlier that day. A senior police officer said the woman had gone to Sonipat to meet Yadav and tell him that she could no longer remain in contact with him. Yadav subsequently dropped her off near Maujpur metro station. When he stopped responding to her calls, she went looking for him and found him lying beside his vehicle near Gate No. 1 of the metro station. She took him to a hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. Around midnight, the Jafrabad police station received information from Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital that a man had been brought dead. items.title: ‘Today I only see denuded land’: Mango orchards give way to Adani’s power plant
items.summary: In Bihar’s Bhagalpur district, a 2,400 MW thermal power plant is rising on land whose true costs are only beginning to surface. Awarded to Adani Power Ltd in a Rs 30,000 crore deal, the Pirpainti project has moved forward through disputed compensation, broken promises, and a public hearing farmers say was engineered to silence them. The two-part series traces what has been erased in the process. The first part examines how hundreds of farmers across 12 villages have watched their orchards vanish without adequate compensation for either land or their orchards. The second turns to a community left out of the process entirely: two Santhal and Pahariya Adivasi hamlets sitting within the project site itself, absent from official lists of affected communities — left with no guaranteed right to compensation or rehabilitation. Adani Power rejected any suggestion of legal or regulatory violations, saying the Pirpainti project is fully compliant and that it supports local communities and jobs. *** On the morning of February 19, Sushil Kumar walked out of a meeting with government officials believing his land and trees would remain safe for 15 days. items.title: Sameer Chugh appointed General Counsel of Diageo India
items.summary: Beverage major Diageo India has appointed corporate lawyer Sameer Chugh as its new General Counsel, effective December 1, 2026. Chugh succeeds Shobhana Nikam, who has decided to step down for personal reasons, effective October 31, 2026, following a four-year tenure. Bengaluru-based Chugh will report directly to Praveen Someshwar, CEO & President, India with a dotted line reporting to Global General Counsel Randall Ingber. He will also join the India Executive Committee and the Global Legal Leadership Team. Chugh brings over 30 years of legal expertise across industries, spanning corporate governance, M&A, litigation and regulatory affairs. He joins Diageo from Games24x7, where he served as Chief Legal Officer and General Counsel. Previously, he was the Group General Counsel at Bharti Group, overseeing legal strategy across multiple businesses and jurisdictions. His career also includes senior leadership roles at British Telecom, Essar Group, and Cummins, alongside private practice at leading law firms.

items.title: Dropping the issue since they have apologised: Lawyer who sent notice to Congress for tweet about CJI
items.summary: Supreme Court lawyer Meenesh Dubey will not be filing a criminal contempt of court case against the Kerala unit of the Congress party for their social media post against Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant. This development comes in light of the Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) tendering an unconditional apology to CJI Kant over a tweet effectively calling for his resignation. The apology was submitted by KPCC President Sunny Joseph in a formal reply dated October 22 to a legal notice issued by Dubey, who is also the joint secretary of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA). When asked whether he would be filing a contempt of court petition, Dubey replied in the negative. "Since they have apologised, I will not be pursuing the matter further," Dubey told Bar & Bench .
